subject: Apply a natural optical vignette: darken the image corners and edges with a smooth radial falloff, centered slightly below the geometric center to simulate real optical lens vignetting. The vignette should be subtle — darkening corners by approximately 1.0 to 1.5 stops with a wide, soft feathering radius. Add a faint desaturation in the darkened zones. The effect should feel like it was part of the optical image capture rather than added in post — present but never distracting.
